params.message:
packages/app goes: gentells.com moved to the Laravel site

The React predecessor of gentells.com (24 files, 8,857 lines) was kept 'until DNS
moves'; gentells.com points to the site box now. With it go the five routes only it
called (/trends/public, /articles/published and their detail routes,
/newsletter/subscribe, /contact, /feedback), their place on the public allow-list,
the build step in deploy.sh, and fable-emphasize.mjs, which only it read.
